name: Fife
eyebrow: East Scotland · The Kingdom of Fife
title: Fife —
title_em: the Kingdom, the Old Course and the East Neuk.
tagline: Golf at St Andrews, fishing villages on the East Neuk and the ancient capital of Dunfermline.
summary: Fife is a peninsula between the Firth of Forth and the Firth of Tay, known as the Kingdom of Fife. It has Scotland's oldest university at St Andrews, the home of golf, and a chain of picturesque fishing villages.
Dunfermline was Scotland's ancient capital and the birthplace of Andrew Carnegie, who gave away much of his fortune to build libraries around the world.
